data.long_description:
Experience elevated living in this beautifully designed 2-bedroom apartment located on a high floor of Vida Dubai Mall Tower 1, in the heart of Downtown Dubai. The property offers breathtaking open views towards Zabeel and the iconic Dubai skyline, creating a serene yet vibrant urban atmosphere.
.
The apartment features a spacious open-plan living and dining area surrounded by floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize natural light and showcase the impressive Zabeel view. The modern kitchen comes with premium finishes, sleek cabinetry, and integrated appliances, combining style with functionality.

Both bedrooms are generously sized with built-in wardrobes. The master bedroom includes a refined en-suite bathroom with high-quality fixtures, while the second bedroom is served by a contemporary guest bathroom.

Residents enjoy access to premium amenities including a fully equipped gym, infinity-style swimming pool, 24/7 concierge service, and direct connectivity to Dubai Mall and Downtown’s main attractions.

An exceptional opportunity for end-users and investors seeking luxury living with uninterrupted Zabeel views in one of Dubai’s most prestigious locations.
